text:
sam_w: FYI customer reported embeddings suddenly changed width after the pinned-model lockstep upgrade. Their index pipeline is erroring.

sam_w: quick paste of what they sent — embedding array truncated to 384 instead of 512: 
```json
{
  \"model\": \"embed-large-v2:locked-2026-03\",
  \"data\": [ { \"embedding\": [0.001, 0.002, ... (384 values) ], \"object\": \"embedding\" } ]
}
```

anya_support: ugh. Do we know whether the pinned variant was swapped to a quantized artefact on the host side?

lee_eng: not yet. I kicked off a query against the model-metadata service for that variant id. If the activation path changed we might be returning a smaller float16 packed vector.

mike_sre: seeing an ops alert at the same time window — routing fallback to regional-compat variant happened at 14:17 UTC. Could be variant aliasing during the lockstep roll.

sam_w: repro steps requested by customer: single request to /v1/embeddings with model=embed-large-v2:locked-2026-03 and their input, got 384 vectors. They did multiple requests; intermittent but ~90% 384.

anya_support: can you paste the curl they used?

sam_w: curl they used: 
```bash
curl -s -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/embeddings \
  -H \"Authorization: Bearer $REDCRED\" \
  -H \"Content-Type: application/json\" \
  -d '{\"model\":\"embed-large-v2:locked-2026-03\",\"input\":\"test doc\"}'
```

lee_eng: I pulled logs for that model variant. The model entry in the catalog shows two variants: \"embed-large-v2:locked-2026-03\" -> backend variant id v3q-quant and a fallback alias to v2f-fp32. Looks like some requests were hitting the quantized flavor which emits 384.

mike_sre: is this a kernel/layout change that reduces output dim? Normally quantization preserves dimension. Could be a serializer bug trimming trailing zeros.

anya_support: temp mitigation for customer?

lee_eng: immediate mitigation options: 1) force routing to the fp32 variant by setting model to the explicit variant id (v2f-fp32) if customer can change their call, or 2) pin to previous released catalog entry (we can roll back the lockstep alias). I'll open an internal rollback if we confirm alias swap.

sam_w: customer can't change quickly — they want us to roll back or provide a compatibility patch. They're blocked in production.

ops_bot: Incident #INC-2026-042 created (severity: high) — action: audit variant alias changes and hold outgoing model-alias updates for locked variants.

mike_sre: I'm running a check on tensor serializer codepath for v3q-quant now. If it's an encoding trim bug we'll push a hotfix; otherwise rollback alias. ETA 30m.

lee_eng: also collecting a small repro set from the customer — can they share raw base64 of the returned embedding? 

sam_w: requested. I'll add their sample to the incident ticket and loop legal if needed.

anya_support: note for support playbook: add a step to verify variant alias -> backend id mapping when pinned upgrades happen. This should reduce finger-pointing.

mike_sre: update: preliminary indicates serializer dropped every 39th element due to a strided memcpy with wrong stride for the 512->384 quant layout. Repro in sandbox ok.

lee_eng: ok that's actionable. Patch to serializer queued; will stage canary build to dedicated infra and run customer repro.

sam_w: customers wants ETA and meanwhile asked for a temporary shim. Can we transcode 384->512 (pad zeros) at gateway as stopgap?

mike_sre: yes we can add a temporary gateway pad for that alias; low risk. I'll attach mitigation script to incident.

ops_bot: Incident #INC-2026-042 update: mitigation applied (gateway padding for alias v3q-quant), rolling patch to serializer in progress.

anya_support: thanks team — I'll update customer: rollback available if they prefer but we have a padding mitigation and a forthcoming patch.

sam_w: ty. Please keep thread updated and add any postmortem notes after fix.
